patterns.note: A persistent vertical text element is fixed to the left edge of the viewport, displaying the brand tagline, while a 'TRACK' indicator is fixed to the right edge.
Large, elegant serif typography is used for all main section headings and the hero statement, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
A predominantly dark background (#15161a) is used across the entire site, providing a sophisticated backdrop for light text and subtle gold/bronze accents.
The hero section scrolls up to reveal the content below, while the background image/video within the hero appears to parallax slightly, moving slower than the foreground text.
Content sections (e.g., 'ABOUT', 'SERVICES') reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The main navigation (logo and menu icon) remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining constant access.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video or large image background that scrolls at a different rate than the overlaying text, creating a parallax effect. This is likely managed by locomotive-scroll for smooth scrolling and GSAP for the parallax calculations.
Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible in the viewport, orchestrated by GSAP ScrollTrigger.
A sticky header and persistent vertical text elements on the page edges are implemented, ensuring they remain fixed in position regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant display serifs for headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter-spacing, contrasted by smaller, highly legible sans-serif for body text and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including images, buttons, and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of luxury and allowing elements to breathe. Content grids within sections are more balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark aesthetic combined with oversized, elegant serif typography and subtle, controlled scroll-triggered motion creates a highly luxurious and editorial brand experience. The persistent vertical text elements on the page edges also add a unique, sophisticated touch.
